title: style(scss): Convert sass to scss, add linting to docs
body:
This is the start of the fix of #538. I managed to make the linting work on the docs css files, but we'll now have to fix the linting issues.

* \[x] Renamed all `sass` files to `scss`
* \[x] Applied linting to all `scss` files, excluding the vendors
* \[x] Created `main.scss` files in `examples` that includes the required front-matter (lines starting with `---`, needed by Jekyll). Those files only `@import` the real `style.scss` and are excluded from the linting process
* \[x] Split lint tasks into `npm run lint:js` and `npm run lint:css`

I now need feedback to see if that's the right track (cc @redox) and we'll then need to fix all the styling issues of the scss files.
